why: The main picture and both covers are infographics, but the story has a known place to show: the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which the story's own hero.need asks for. Together with the Cricket and Andhra infographics this pushes the homepage top over the one-third infographic limit. The figures on it (Nikkei -6.2% 'in morning trade', Kospi -7.1% 'later in the morning') date from about 7 am IST. Tokyo's morning session closed at 8 am IST, so they are already stale.
